title: Translations
description: AI translates your menu, a second, independent model checks every translation – with a back-translation into your source language so you can verify the meaning yourself.
creditsHint: Each batch of up to 40 texts uses 2 credits (translation + review).
noLocalesDescription: Enable the languages your guests should read your menu in under settings. Then you can translate here.
progressDescription: Source language: {source}. Guests automatically see outdated or flagged texts in the source language.
listDescription: Click a translation to edit it. Saved edits count as approved by you.
retranslateHint: Translate and review this text again (2 credits).
confirmOverwriteHuman: This translation was approved by a person. Replace it with a new AI translation anyway?
reviewOnlyHint: Check only: get a score and back-translation, text stays unchanged (1 credit).
noBackHuman: Written by hand – use “AI check” to get a back-translation.
scoreHint: Score from an independent reviewer model (5 = perfect).
noTextsHint: Add categories and dishes to your menu first.
bulkConfirm: Approve {n} machine translations with a score of at least {score}?
jobNothing: Nothing to do – everything is up to date.
jobCreditsWarning: This needs about {needed} credits, {remaining} are available. Translation continues while credits last.
jobDone: {translated} texts translated: {approved} auto-approved, {review} need your review.
legendMachine: = translated by AI and checked by a second model without objections. Approve them for full certainty.
qualityDescription: How we make sure translations are right.
how1: An AI model translates – using your glossary and without inventing ingredients.
how2: A second model from a different vendor checks each translation, scores it and translates it back.
how3: Automatic checks: numbers, quantities and glossary terms must match.
how4: Anything uncertain goes to “Reviews” – guests see the original until then.
guestsSeeOnlyApprovedOn: Machine translations are shown only after your approval.
guestsSeeOnlyApprovedOff: Checked machine translations are shown right away, uncertain ones never.
autoApproveHint: Only if the reviewer finds no issues and had nothing to correct.
glossaryDescription: Fixed translations and terms that are never translated (e.g. house specialities, brand names).
glossaryHint: The glossary applies to new translations. Use “Re-translate” to update existing texts.
